data_fields.name: brick_sabrina_value
data_fields.donor_constant: signed integer per brick: + cost, - credit (sheet Basics.SabrinaCost)

data_fields.name: success_table_index
data_fields.donor_constant: index = 50 - level; table values from sheet (not read)

data_fields.name: armour_casting_malus
data_fields.donor_constant: getArmorCastingMalus() * skill, minus _ArmorCompensation, clamped at 0 (fraction not read)

best_idea: Make a spell a list of brick parts with signed cost and credit values, so the level (skill + credit - 2 * cost) / 10 picks a success chance from a table and a roll decides critical, success, partial or fail, so a badly built spell is weaker or fails instead of being forbidden.
decision_why: Take the credit-and-cost level and the roll bands and drop the hard over-cost reject: spells are catalogue rows, the server rolls once per cast, and a cost-heavy spell should lose chance rather than be blocked. Coin is not used by the donor; skill points are its learn currency.
acceptance: A caster with skill 100 casts a spell with credit 20 and cost 30: level = (100 + 20 - 60) / 10 = 6, table index 44, and the server log shows one of critical, success, partial or fail; a unit test asserts relativeLevel and successFactor at the band edges for four fixture spells and refuses a zero-mana caster before the roll.
